qualification.details: B.Sc. (Nursing) or General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) from an Institute/University recognized by the Nursing Council of India / respective State Nursing Council. Should be registered with the Nursing Council of India / State Nurses', Midwives' and Health Visitors' Council. GNM - minimum two (2) year post-registration experience or B.Sc Nursing - minimum one (1) year post-registration experience as a Staff Nurse in a recognized hospital.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIPER Hajipur Temporary Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Hajipur Temporary Staff Nurse recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application via email is 14th October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Temporary Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Nursing) or General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) qualification from a recognized institution and be registered with the relevant nursing council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Temporary Staff Nurse position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Temporary Staff Nurse position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Temporary Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Temporary Staff Nurse position at NIPER Hajipur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Temporary Staff Nurse role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve Certificate Verification followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NIPER/HJP/HEALTHCENTRE/2026-27/4.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIPER Hajipur located?
faq.answer: NIPER Hajipur is located in Hajipur, Bihar, with the pincode 844102.
